The thunder spends itself upon the peak, and the sky clears to a sea of stars. Let your qi settle like silt in still water.
Your sword returns to its sheath with a sound like falling jade. Even immortals lay down the blade at dusk.
Lightning has tempered the vessel; now the night will cool it. A breakthrough is sealed in stillness.
The last challenger bows and leaves the arena. The moon is yours, and the wine, and the silence.
Cranes return to the pines of the sect. The mountain gate swings shut; the Dao heart rests.
Peach blossoms drift where the battle was. Nothing more is asked of you beneath this sky.
The incense has burned to its root. Breathe out the day; your meridians run clear as mountain streams.
Across the cloud-sea, the elders nod once. The scroll is written to its end.
Heaven tested you with its whole storm, and the storm has passed. Rest, cultivator.
